# NLTK English stopwords, snapshotted for ICR content-word filtering.
# nltk==3.10.3  corpus=stopwords/english  retrieved=2026-08-31
# 198 entries.
#
# PINNED ON PURPOSE. nltk.corpus.stopwords needs a network fetch
# (nltk.download) which fails on Kaggle with networking off, and the list
# changes between NLTK releases -- an unpinned word list inside the
# measuring instrument would silently move every ICR number on upgrade.
# Same reasoning as B5 pinning the text normaliser.
# Do not edit by hand. Normalise entries on load: this list contains
# apostrophe forms the Whisper normaliser expands, so unnormalised entries
# would never match and would silently fail to filter.
# decisions-m4.md 2026-08-31.
